description: Threads API lets apps publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and read insights.
auth_notes: Threads user access tokens conforming to OAuth 2.0; short-lived (1 hour) exchangeable for long-lived tokens, with per-permission scopes such as threads_basic.
gate_detail: Create a Meta app with the Threads use case. Testers with a role can grant permissions immediately; other app users require each permission to pass App Review and the app to be published.
api_scope: Create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, mentions, insights, keyword search, webhooks and oEmbed.
mcp_notes: Meta's official MCP servers cover Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Ads and app devtools; none is described for Threads content.
blocker_detail: Permissions for app users without a role on the app require App Review approval and a published app.
